response.sql: SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The total record count is the sum of record counts across all groups after the join and the traitcount >= 489 filter (not the count before filtering). With no groups, no rows are returned.
The fraction is computed with floating-point division so it is not truncated by integer division, and no rounding is applied.
